C0357.title: Guancheng Hui District Court in Zhengzhou Sentences Defendant in Credential Stuffing Personal Information Theft Case
C0357.summary: Between May 2020 and November 2021, the defendant Zhang purchased QQ email accounts and passwords through QQ groups and used credential stuffing techniques to compromise accounts on other websites for profit. The case was tried and adjudicated by the Guancheng Hui District People's Court in Zhengzhou.

references.title: One set of account passwords for the entire web? Beware of 'credential stuffing' stealing your personal info
